title: Whose Truth? Pluralistic Geo-Alignment for (Agentic) AI
reasoning: The paper is centered on the concept of 'geo-alignment,' which it defines as the challenge of ensuring AI systems behave in accordance with societal norms, values, and ethics across different geographic regions. It includes a specific section titled 'Ethics of GeoAI' and discusses moral correctness and value pluralism as core components of its proposed framework.
